description: Multi-facet search of audiobooks: combine genre, narrator, max price, year range. Use when an agent has structured constraints rather than a free-form query. V1 supports genre + narrator + price_max + year filters; partner filter coming in V2.

genre_slug.description: Genre slug to anchor the search. Discoverable via browse_genres. Example: "detektivky".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. 1–50, default 20.

narrator_slug.description: Narrator slug to anchor the search. Example: "lukas-hlavica".

partner_slug.description: Reserved for V2 — partner-side filtering is not yet implemented and will throw if set.

price_max_czk.description: Maximum price in CZK applied as a post-filter on each result row.

year_max.description: Latest publication year (inclusive). V1 accepts but skips this filter.

year_min.description: Earliest publication year (inclusive). V1 accepts but skips this filter.

name: search_by_filters
title: Search by Filters
